labels: AI by-eye labels (WP3 part 2), test video: scoring only
rule: as for the dev clip: event frame = first frame whose centre (960, 540) shows the other side of the surface (exit: sky / horizon / the back in air, even through droplets or a water sheet; entry: the water column including froth); crossing = frames in between (foam / tearing surface film). Frames where the lens is just under the surface and the centre shows the brown total reflection of the back below the sky window count as underwater. Revised 2026-11-20 (boundary cases): the half-out phase of an exit (circular waterline rim across the dome, brownish band at the centre) is crossing; the sky through a rippled Snell window with the brown reflection around it stays underwater.
